name: python-url-signing
title: URL Signing
blurb: Signed requests over a canonical form instead of a raw URL. Percent escapes are decoded and re-encoded in uppercase, so %7E and ~ agree while a plus and a space do not; query parameters are sorted, so reordering a request does not break it. The signing string puts one fact per line, so a header value cannot forge a boundary. Signatures carry an expiry and a nonce: a replay is refused, the body is covered by its hash, and a header outside the signed set is a header an attacker may rewrite. Every refusal names which rule failed.
default_description: Signed requests over a canonical form, with expiries, nonces and refusal messages that say which rule failed.
